_deal: The live local-cargo pool, as every lettered recipe since 2026-10-12.
author: jessica
source: his 2026-10-12 14:34: "just as a test, are you able to see the gaps we have and build a mission from that? make 13a"
_note: THE PICNIC, built FROM THE GAPS, counted over the 13 recipes on 2026-10-12, not felt:
1. PLACE: LocTypeOE_ThemeNaturalKeyword is the largest theme in the POI pool (144 of 491, gen_delve keywords),
and 0 of 13 recipes require it while 7 exclude it (the base quest excludes it too). A stranger on 09-23 named
non-combat missions at Natural Landmark POIs as what Overtime does well. So this one REQUIRES natural.
2. TONE: 4 of 13 are about someone's loss (06a medal, 06b clasp, 08a letters, 11a bag) and 0 are funny.
So this one is light: a courier drone dropped a proposal picnic in the wrong spot.
Mechanics are deliberately known (pickup, pickup, deliver, like 08a on one place): the gap was where and what,
not how. Calm, no combat. The lint warns that it drops the base's natural exclusion: that is the point of it,
the same move he ruled on 09a.
Boxes on the two pickups (calm moments); the deliver speaks instead (either or). Boxes describe objects only,
never the site and never a person (rules 2 and 'never describe the site').
MODEL NOT ON THE APPROVED LIST, his eye first: BeachBlanket01.nif (vanilla BeachBlanket01) as the picnic spot.
Found on the way: vanilla has RockCairns_01 to 04 (SetDressing\StoneCairns), Kim's wish-list #8, a candidate

place._theme: Natural sites only, and never a cave: a proposal wants open sky.

prose.name: Errand: Proposal Picnic on <Planet>
prose.briefing: A courier drone was meant to set out a proposal picnic at the <Place> and came down in the wrong spot. Somebody is about to have a very awkward evening unless it gets sorted.

beats.objective: Find the courier drop at the <Place>
beats.name: Split Courier Crate

message.title: Split Courier Crate
message.text: The crate split open on landing. A small ring box has a note taped to it: DO NOT OPEN. Underneath, smaller: sorry.

message.title: Courier Hamper
message.text: The hamper bounced further than the ring did. The bottle inside survived. Both glasses did not.

beats.journal: A courier drone dropped somebody's proposal picnic in the wrong spot at the <Place>. I found the ring and the hamper and laid it all out where it was meant to be. I did not open the small box.
beats.name: Picnic Spot
say: Okay. Okay. I can do this.

broadcast: I've got a very important picnic tonight, and the drone dropped it in the wrong place.
Please don't open the small box.
_speech: Radio rules: no names, no places. Voice is ElevenLabs' 'Will, Relaxed Optimist', NOT heard in game; a nervous man in a relaxed voice is the joke, his ear decides.
